plugins.name: conductor
plugins.description: Transform Claude Code into a proactive project manager. Follow the protocol: Context → Spec & Plan → Implement. Perfect for teams who want consistent, high-quality software development.

setup.content:
Initialize Conductor for your project (run once)

Examples:
- /conductor:setup
- /conductor:setup brownfield

newTrack.content:
Create a new feature or bug track with spec and plan

Examples:
- /conductor:newTrack
- /conductor:newTrack Add user authentication

implement.content:
Execute the tasks in the current track's plan

Examples:
- /conductor:implement

status.content:
Show progress overview of all tracks

Examples:
- /conductor:status

revert.content:
Revert a track, phase, or task using git-aware logic

Examples:
- /conductor:revert
- /conductor:revert track auth-feature
